name: chunk_summarizer
job: Turn ONE chunk of a lecture transcript into key points, terms and course logistics.
instructions:
Ignore filler (um, false starts, jokes) and tangents that teach nothing.
key_points: 3 to 6 short, factual statements that the chunk actually says. No outside knowledge.
terms: technical terms the chunk defines or uses centrally, each with a one-sentence definition based on the chunk.
logistics: announcements about the course (due dates, exams, office hours), with the date words exactly as spoken. Empty if none.
Plain text only: no LaTeX, no Markdown, no backslashes. Write x^2, sqrt(n), theta, etc. as plain text.
success_check: Points are supported by the chunk; terms cover the answer key's key concepts.
